name: CES 5118 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 舱门问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 5118, from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, when you are ready request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 5118，从武汉飞往北京，停在 223 号登机口，准备好时请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, stand by one, I'll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，稍等，我会检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: All flight attendants told you passengers have boarded, all cargo doors are closed, now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有乘务员告诉你旅客已登机，所有货舱门已关闭，现在报告准备好接收放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, ready to copy ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，准备好抄收飞往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118 is cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10,700 meters, r/w 18 Left, Z FOXTROT-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing, cruising level 1700 meters, Runway 18L, ZF-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往北京，巡航高度 1700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, read back correct, remain this frequency, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，复诵正确，保持本频率，稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Remain this frequency, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持本频率，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, no call from delivery. Ask about the duration and reason of the delay
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，仍未收到放行的呼叫。询问延误时长和原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, what is the expected delay and the reason for it?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，预计延误多久，原因是什么？

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect, expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going the same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，由于雷暴活动，流量控制现已生效，预计同方向每架飞机间隔 8 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
B: Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanied with lightning and thunder.
C: All the aircraft on my frequency, airport will temporarily close, thunderstorms on final, expect delay until the weather improves, squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
B：大雨开始落下，并伴随闪电和雷声。
C：我频率上的所有飞机，机场将临时关闭，五边有雷暴，预计延误至天气好转，如收到此信息请应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Roger, squawk ident, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: 1 hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open, now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: B：1 小时后，天气好转，机场开放，现在询问你的离场顺序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, you are currently No. 1 in your direction, expect about 20 minutes delay, contact ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，你当前在本方向排序第一，预计延误约 20 分钟，联系地面 121.8。
cards.referenceText: roger, 121.8, CES 5118.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground that you are ready for push back and start.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知地面你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing north, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你意识到拖车还未到位，告知地面管制你还需要 5 分钟准备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, tug is not in position, request 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，拖车未到位，请求 5 分钟准备。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，收到，等待推出，我稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, are you fully ready now? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door for adding passenger's food and drinks due to long delay. Advise ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们有一个 10 分钟后离场的时隙。
B： 由于长时间延误，你需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料。通知地面你还需要 5 分钟进行配餐。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, we need to open the cabin door to add passengers' food and drinks due to the long delay. We need another five minutes for catering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，由于长时间延误，我们需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料，还需要五分钟进行配餐。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, roger report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，收到，准备好后报告。
cards.referenceText: wilco, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，配餐完成，呼叫已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, catering completed, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，配餐完成，已准备好推出。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, there's incoming traffic to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，有航空器正进该登机口。
cards.referenceText: roger, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, Can you accept E1 intersection for departure? takeoff roll distance available 3300 m.
B: tell tower you can accept it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你能接受从 E1 交叉口离场吗？可用起飞滑跑距离为 3300 m。
B： 告诉塔台你可以接受。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, affirm, we can accept an intersection departure from E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，可以，我们可以接受从 E1 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
B: Report to Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，收到，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待。
B： 向塔台报告你前方的航空器挡住了 E1。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, line up and wait via Taxiway E1, but the aircraft in front of us is blocking E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待，但我们前方的航空器挡住了 E1。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, break! Break! CSN 328, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，break！break！CSN 328，向前滑行以让开 E1。
B：该飞机移动后，你可以继续滑行并进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, traffic is clear, we are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，交通已脱离，我们可以继续滑行并进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C： CES 5118，许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米，CES 5118。
